models.notes: Mistral uses RPS (requests per second), TPM, and tokens/month - not RPM. Actual limits are only visible after login at admin.mistral.ai/plateforme/limits. No public numerical figures. European data residency (GDPR).

free.notes: Limited rate limits for evaluation and prototyping only. Upgrade to Scale plan to increase.

tier-1.notes: Scale plan (pay-as-you-go). Actual limits in admin console.

tier-2.notes: Automatic upgrade. Actual limits in admin console.

tier-3.notes: Automatic upgrade. Actual limits in admin console.

tier-4.notes: Automatic upgrade. Contact support for higher limits.
